cards.text: About eight days after Jesus tells His disciples He must suffer, be killed and be raised to life (Luke 9:22), He takes three of them with Him: Peter, John and James. Out of the whole group, only THREE get the invite. Friend, the day I got picked, I was at the bottom of a bargain bin wearing a 25 cent sticker.

cards.question: Jesus takes Peter, John and James up on a mountain. What does He go up there to do?

cards.text: Up on the mountain, as Jesus prays, the appearance of His face changes and His clothes become radiantly white. Friend, I scrub flour out of this apron every single day, and it has NEVER looked like that.

Then, SUDDENLY, two men are there talking with Jesus: Moses, Israel's leader, and Elijah, the prophet. Friend, if two people showed up in my bakery out of nowhere, I'd be face first in the chocolate chips.

cards.question: Moses and Elijah appear in glory and talk with Jesus on the mountain. What do they talk about?

cards.text: Meanwhile, Peter and his companions are overcome by sleep, with Moses and Elijah RIGHT THERE. Friend, I've dozed off next to a warm oven more times than I can count, so I'm not saying a word.

cards.question: True or false: when Peter and his companions wake up and see Jesus' glory, Moses and Elijah are already gone.

cards.text: As Moses and Elijah are leaving, Peter speaks up: “Master, it is good for us to be here.” I think Peter wants this moment to last, friend.

cards.question: Peter wants to put up three ___ on the mountain: one for Jesus, one for Moses and one for Elijah.
Right after Peter's idea about the shelters, the writer adds a short note about Peter. What does it say?

answers.text: He did not know what he was saying
He had learned it from Moses
He had been planning it for days

cards.text: Peter isn't even done talking when a cloud appears and wraps all around them. Mid-sentence, friend.

cards.question: True or false: the disciples are afraid as they enter the cloud.

cards.text: Then a voice comes from the cloud, saying, “This is My Son, whom I have chosen…”

cards.question: Peter was still talking when the cloud came. Now the voice from the cloud gives the disciples a command about Jesus. What is it?

cards.text: After the voice has spoken, the disciples look around. Friend, I'd be checking that whole mountain twice.

cards.question: After the voice from the cloud has spoken, only ___ is present with the disciples.
True or false: in those days, the disciples tell everyone what they saw on the mountain.
